messages:
Alex Chen: starting the phased rollout window now — US first. plan: canary 5% -> monitor 15m -> ramp to 25% if healthy. pin version `v3.4.2` for this slice. can everyone run quick capacity checks? :eyes:
Priya Patel: checking dashboards now — warm pool at 82%, active queues ~3.1k, steady RPS. link: https://dash.internal/redwood/serve/heatmap
Marco Rivera: will pre-warm +4 instances in us-west. command I used earlier:
```bash
./infractl warm-pool --region us-west --add 4 --profile fast-start
```
Marco Rivera: also setting rollout pin: `redwood deploy pin --model all --version v3.4.2 --region us`
deploy-bot: canary created: region=us percent=5 version=v3.4.2 timestamp=6312349901. monitoring hooks attached. :rocket:
ops-bot: noticed slight tail latency bump in eu during last warmup (p95 +120ms). not critical but FYI. tagging @Lina Gomez
Lina Gomez: thanks. please hold APAC until we validate EU warm pool after US canary. if OOM rate >0.5% or pod restarts spike, hold APAC and notify.
Theo (oncall): I'm on watch. alert thresholds: error-rate >= 0.6% OR p95+200ms -> rollback trigger. I'll watch the canary channel.
Alex Chen: agreed — proceed with US canary now. Priya, Marco, keep pre-warm / throttle commands handy. if anything, we hit the hold.
Priya Patel: kicked a pre-warm +2 in us-east too. queue drain looks fine. I'll post snapshots every 5m.
Marco Rivera: observed queuing drop after warm-up; token throughput steady.
deploy-bot: canary metrics @6312350400: success signals: tok/s stable, error-rate 0.09%, p95 +30ms. no OOMs.
Alex Chen: nice. ramping to 25% in 2m. pin remains v3.4.2.
deploy-bot: ramp issued: region=us percent=25 timestamp=6312350605. watch window 15m.
ops-bot: EU warm pool still rebuilding; recommend +1 instance before EU canary. APAC on hold per @Lina.
Lina Gomez: adding +1 to eu-west now. will re-evaluate in 10m.
Theo (oncall): seeing a small uptick in cpu steal on a subset of us nodes — tracking. will alert if trend continues.
Alex Chen: thanks team. next sync at +10m or earlier on alert. :thumbsup:
Marco Rivera: noted — saving rollout notes to release board. snippet: `Release: v3.4.2 | US canary -> 25% | EU warmup | APAC hold`
Priya Patel: snapshots: 6312350700, 6312351000 posted to the ops channel.
deploy-bot: canary window healthy at midpoint. no rollback triggers met.
Alex Chen: holding APAC until EU stabilizes; if EU metrics look good at +20m we'll schedule APAC warmup +30m after that.
